Thank you for writing to the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways regarding the disruption to your companion animal travel plan. You reported that your pet’s crate was misplaced during transit and that the communication you received after booking did not match the level of clarity you expected.

We understand how stressful this situation feels, especially when you are trying to keep your pet calm and secure. Our department coordinates care from booking through pickup, and we use humane, calm handling methods throughout the process. When a crate is not where it should be, the priority becomes locating it while protecting animal welfare and maintaining chain-of-care documentation for transparency.

<<FACT F118>>. To support your claim efficiently, please ensure you have the crate identifier from your travel paperwork and any relevant contact details you provided at booking. If you have already submitted a claim, please allow time for verification and for the responsible station handlers to confirm custody and scan records.

<<FACT F112>>. This standard payout applies based on the incident category for lost crate, and it is designed to provide predictable resolution without requiring additional back-and-forth. If your circumstances involved any special care considerations for Scout, include a short written note describing those needs, as this can help us prevent similar oversights during subsequent transfers.

In the meantime, our team can help confirm the current status of the crate once your claim file is matched to the correct itinerary and passenger profile. If you traveled with Sana Chaudhary or Milan Dubois, note that the desk can align documentation across parties when needed to maintain consistent updates.

Thank you again for your patience while we work to close the loop and support safe, respectful travel for all companions.
